sources.reading_depth: Abstract, introduction and preprocessing methods; PMC retrieval succeeded, later find encountered browser challenge. Publisher full-text tool returned redirect failure.
sources.finding: Szalai et al. connected LINCS signatures to viability and found generic death/proliferation signals can confound mechanism matching. Their prediction methods also show useful signal is possible.
sources.application: Motivates feature/projection sensitivity only. Current PCA adjustment is not their validated viability model, has no measured viability labels and may remove real biology.

sources.reading_depth: Abstract, results on genetic/chemical assay concordance, discussion and L1000 methods. No independent supplement review.
sources.finding: Cas9 introduction can change p53 signaling and selection, and affect genetic and chemical screens. MCF7 nutlin response was one experiment.
sources.application: Require editing/vector controls and evaluate selection. This does not establish that the current MCF7 everolimus or HT29 BUB1B connection is artifactual.

sources.finding: PLM likelihood can encode sequence-sampling/species biases.
sources.application: Background-relative description, not biological calibration. No evidence that this specific within-human mutation score is caused by species bias.

sources.reading_depth: Official local inference, model/SDK and runtime documentation.
sources.finding: Local ESMC and ESM3 paths are available; use frozen already-verified source/checkpoints for numerical continuity. Skill text mentioning 6B hosted-only and old SDK is outdated.

sources.reading_depth: Pinned root README, ESMC README/STOCK/CHANGES and PINS; five local source copies/hashes archived.
sources.finding: Reference optimization release, no maintenance promise, per-kit upstream pins and exact mode. ESMC pins 3.4.0 and older model revisions; our campaign preserves 3.4.1.post1 and its prior checkpoints.
sources.application: Reviewed but not installed/executed. No speedup/exact-mode equivalence claimed. Plan wording about BF16 refers to the documented example; we did not establish that the kit cannot serve FP32. SDK/checkpoint continuity is the decisive reason.

sources.reading_depth: Indexed primary abstract only. Publisher failed; PMC returned browser challenge.
sources.application: Not used as evidence for a measured outcome or full-paper claim.
